({{Price|1000}}) |ingredients = {{Name|Iron Bar|1}}{{Name|Battery Pack|1}} |sellprice = Cannot be sold }} The '''Iron Lamp-post''' is a [[Crafting#Lighting|crafted lighting item]] that can be held or placed to provide light. The recipe can be purchased from the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|1000}}. The iron lamp-post influences a radius of approximately 7 tiles, with most of the illumination within the closest few tiles. The lamp can be placed indoors or outdoors, or in places like [[the Mines]]. It can be removed by striking it with a [[Hoes|Hoe]], a [[Pickaxes|Pickaxe]], or an [[Axes|Axe]]. Unlike the braziers, which can toggle on and off, the [[Wood Lamp-post|Wood]] and Iron Lamp-posts are always on. They provide more light than any other craftable lighting. {{NavboxLighting}} [[Category:Craftable lighting]] [[de:Laternenpfahl, Eisen]] [[es:Farola de hierro]] [[fr:Lampadaire en fer]] [[it:Lampione di ferro]] [[ja:鉄の街灯]] [[ko:철제 가로등]] [[hu:Vas lámpaoszlop]] [[pt:Poste de luz férreo]] [[ru:Железный фонарь]] [[tr:Demir Lamba Direği]] [[zh:铁灯柱]]
